client_server_mismatch.stderr: Error response from daemon: client version 1.44 is too new. Maximum supported API version is 1.41
client_server_mismatch.note: The classifier has no branch for a client/server API version mismatch, so this falls through to the generic 'daemon-error'. It is also raised by `docker version`, while the probe only classifies `docker info` stderr. Distinguishing it would add the rule id containers/docker-version-mismatch.
